assumptions.statement: Site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional rough polygons from the repository. They are used only for generation, visualization, discussion, and intake self-check.
assumptions.impact: All geometry, metrics, figures, and HTML must be recalculated after official polygons are released. Provisional geometry cannot support official redline, approval, or precise-area claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official SITE_BOUNDARY or KEY_AREA GeoJSON published in the repository.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, green ratio, and setback controls are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: FAR and height metrics are marked unknown; development-intensity conclusions are conceptual suggestions pending official regulatory conditions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Approved regulatory planning conditions or official design brief attachments published.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual massing blocks generated from the provisional land-use partition; they are not approved building plans.
assumptions.impact: Building density and footprint metrics are indicative design targets only.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official building conditions or survey data available.

assumptions.statement: Road centerlines are schematic design suggestions derived from the grid partition; existing primary roads are shown as low-confidence context lines.
assumptions.impact: No road redline or engineering alignment claims are made.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official road redlines or engineering plans available.

assumptions.statement: Existing primary roads, rail corridor, and water features are schematic context lines from public knowledge/OSM background; they are not survey data.
assumptions.impact: Context lines support narrative only and do not carry statutory or ownership claims.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Official survey or clearing data available.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios, event programs, policies, and operations are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen; none are approved government arrangements or confirmed implementation.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is presented as approved operation; privacy and human review boundaries are stated per scenario.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Organizer or community confirmation of scenario feasibility.

assumptions.statement: Cultural narrative and landmark concepts reference public heritage facts; any use of images, fonts, logos, portraits, or trademarks requires clearance before publication.
assumptions.impact: This package contains no unauthorized third-party assets; figure art is generated by the agent.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Before any external republication of visual assets.
